summary: One node of a violet-tree; child violet-tree-item elements make it a branch.

usage.text: The label goes in the default slot. Child violet-tree-item elements become its branch and are moved to the slot named item automatically; do not set that slot yourself.
Clicking the chevron toggles the branch; clicking elsewhere on the row selects the item. Both work only inside violet-tree, which handles the item's select-request and toggle-request events.
For a branch whose children load later, set the expandable attribute, then append the child items when the tree fires expanded-change for it.
The value attribute falls back to the label text for selection and event details. The expanded and selected attributes can be set in markup for the initial state.
